review_notes: Independently read the complete canonical and rendered implementation and header, all 38 subject records, all 72 baseline facts, all 25 outgoing links, the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, and both disposition ledgers. The current proposal differs materially from the prior librarian packet; this verdict applies only to the input SHA reported above.
All eleven proposed writes concern owned subjects and are supported by canonical source. The proposal contains no new links, entities, merges, or follow-ups.
The proposed reset correction is valid: void(void) returns normally, clears nine pointers, and performs neither traversal nor deallocation.

The constructor's return-to-start termination really does leave its recorded first and last line IDs equal. AB54 compares the current ID before its final-ID guard and therefore does not enumerate the other members of such an initial closed chain. The proposal and functionality document correctly avoid promising complete cycle membership lookup.

Independently inspected mpCheckFloor confirms strict squared-distance candidate replacement, F32_MAX initialization, earlier-candidate tie retention, the ay>=by condition in its near-horizontal branch, and conditional bounding setup/cleanup. mpUncheckBounding writes joint flags and didCheckBounding. The current proposal correctly repairs the prior globally read-only AC14 claim rather than preserving it through a local-only qualification.

ACE8's both-output scan condition, else-if precedence, never-cleared availability flags, repeated output overwrites, and output-aliasing caveat are supported. Its endpoint helpers follow connectivity rather than simply returning the selected line's immediate vertex.

AE1C's implemented endpoint-span comparisons can select a span for zero count. Its migrations are conditional on both input partition and status bit; it does not normalize inconsistent partitions. Prepending reverses traversed groups.

B004's asymmetric closed-cycle comparisons are accurately described without assigning a rightmost-extremum intent. Empty dynamic ranges still recycle selected-joint nodes. All rebuilt nodes enter the same dynamic output regardless of their status.
Foreign callers confirm that B334 activity is caller policy: some paths use Enabled && !(Hidden|B11), individual line toggles and joint addition use !B11, and joint removal passes false.

CPU descriptor-identity comparisons, cached-endpoint consumers, the active Story classifier arm, and downstream destination gating substantiate navigation relationships. Numbered joint flags do not independently establish visible stage surfaces or original semantic names.

Palette construction and its active terrain-drawing consumer are verified. Section placement, complete descriptor layout, exact DEVELOP-mode gating, and other expressly deferred claims remain unresolved, not proved by this acceptance.

The TU data_flow proposal enriches the existing supported topology-flow fact with palette consumption. The ledger's retain disposition for that baseline fact is compatible with retaining its supported substance while applying the proposed enrichment.

renderer_issues: AB54 and AC14 have shadowed_binding notices and remain canonical in rendered declarations. Rendered substitutions were not treated as independent semantic evidence.

unresolved: No supplied compiled evidence proves section sizes, object-to-section associations, emitted float-constant placement, or complete mp_UnkStruct0 layout. All section facts and section-origin links remain unresolved.

mp_UnkStruct0 declares x2A and ptr beyond the fields initialized here, while allocations request 0x2C bytes. The compiled size, trailing-field validity and intended allocation contract require separate verification.
Initial return-to-start chains have coincident recorded first/final IDs, limiting AB54 lookup. Actual stage-data exposure and intended treatment of such chains remain unknown.
B004's closed-cycle v1 comparison is not a rightmost-extremum calculation for finite coordinates. Original intent, matching-binary behavior and stage-data reachability remain unknown.

Exact original function names, individual B8/B9/B10 semantic names and visible Story-stage surface mappings remain unknown. Observed transform writers and CPU exclusion consumers do not prove exhaustive meanings.

mpCheckFloor's strict candidate selection and bounding cleanup are verified, but detailed intersection behavior for zero extent, NaN, infinity and other exceptional inputs remains unresolved. No universal nearest-represented-island guarantee is established.

Whole-system reclamation, long-lived borrowed pointer validity, reentrancy safety, valid joint ownership, safe index narrowing, visited-index bounds and guarantees excluding malformed adjacency or list cycles remain external invariants.
Exact DEVELOP-mode gating is unproved; only the active terrain-drawing branch and palette flow are established.
Register-labelled parameter subjects were fully enumerated and have no baseline facts. Source parameter order does not establish physical register bindings; no register-specific writes are proposed.

Universal effective exclusion of inactive-marked descriptors is not proved. Initial and rebuilt dynamic status-2 nodes can remain in primary lists, and AB54 checks line availability rather than descriptor x20.

Retained high-level topology and endpoint claims are limited by the independently documented cycle, optional-output, aliasing and partition qualifications; they are not proofs of unrestricted behavior outside those conditions.
